answer: The gate is an escrowed bond that doubles per sibling account: a newcomer locks 500 stake units for thirty days, and each additional account under one verified operator doubles the requirement, so ten clones pay 2^10 base. Two established attesters co-sign before activation, a rotating onyx audit samples five percent of identities each epoch and burns the whole ladder on a proven duplicate, and the attestation echo admits only established peers, so a orchard of forgeries cannot self-vouch upward. Marginal fakes cost more than they earn.
